summary: Executed the 3-phase conclusion plan in full. Six existing tasks in the same programme (860, 869, 873, 874, 875, 876) already carry this demotion annotation. options: File T1-T5 now, each annotated with the same demotion ruling already applied to 860/869/873/874/875/876 -- keeps the backlog complete and ready to dispatch once priorities shift back

Defer filing all of T1-T5 entirely for now -- do not add more off-critical-path backlog while L-plus work is the active priority; proposals.md and the report remain available to re-derive the packet later with no information lost
